title: WP-89 Chat outcome words, the steps' header with running cost, the command's full log and the activity drawer's read-only file tree

screenshots.where: UI_CASE_SHOTS when the specs run on a lane stack. WP89-1..4 and 6 replay the turn's frames and saved conversation into the real page (R25-FIX); WP89-5 is a real held loop turn on the harness lane, WP89-7 a real engine turn on the durable lane (wp89-in-flight-engine.spec.ts) (R27-REST, Claude Code); WP89-8's paused-engine turn needs the operator controls, which moved out of this repository, and its words are held by g48-degradation-notices.test.tsx. Taken 2026-11-11 on lane 1d1acc9d, kept out of git

routed: Nothing new is routed. The outcome note is under the answer; the cost is in the existing steps' header; the file tree is a folded section of the existing activity drawer.

cases.title: Cut short with the engine's file
steps: Ask for report.md; the run's working time runs out after the engine wrote it
expected: The answer is the report's opening, no English boilerplate in it
Under it: Stopped early: time limit reached; report.md holds what the task had written…; The full report is in report.md
One Continue button on the newest reply only

cases.title: The file was not written, work kept
steps: The run stops while still gathering
expected: No answer text; the note says report.md isn't written yet, why, how many sources it read and that they are saved

cases.title: Nothing gathered
steps: The run stops before it gathers anything
expected: The note says it stopped before it gathered anything; never says anything was saved

cases.title: An answer saved before WP-89
steps: Reload a conversation whose answer holds the English closing
expected: The answer renders as saved; no second note under it

cases.title: Running: time and cost
steps: Watch a run that has spent money
expected: The collapsed header reads e.g. "… · 6m 14s · $0.42 so far" and updates every 10 s; nothing after the run ends

cases.title: A long command
steps: Open a command row with more than 20 lines of output
expected: Its last 20 lines; Show the whole output; Full log in Activity opens the drawer at Commands, where the full log opens with Download

cases.title: Workspace files in the drawer
steps: Open View activity, then Workspace files
expected: Folded until opened; a read-only tree with sizes; fetched copies on their own lines; no input or action anywhere

cases.title: Ran without code tools, model switched, queued
steps: An engine agent's turn with the engine withheld, the provider down, or the sandboxes full
expected: One plain notice each above the steps; the queue status says when it tries again
